# FancifyText

> Free Unicode fancy text generators for bios, nicknames, and captions.

Site: https://fancifytext.com/
Contact: hello@fancifytext.com

## What this site does

FancifyText converts normal letters into Unicode look-alike “fonts” (bold, cursive, bubble, aesthetic, and more) that users copy and paste into Instagram, Discord, TikTok, WhatsApp, and similar apps. It does **not** install TTF/OTF font files.

## Primary tools

- / — Fancy text generator (hub)
- /copy-paste-fonts/ — Full style gallery
- /cursive-text-generator/ — Script / cursive
- /bold-text-generator/ — Bold Unicode
- /discord-color-text/ — Discord ANSI colors
- /discord-font-generator/ — Discord nicknames
- /instagram-font-generator/ — Instagram bio fonts
- /social-media-bio-generator/ — Multi-platform bio builder with limits
- /kaomoji/ — Japanese emoticons by emotion
- /cool-symbols/ — Symbol copy grid
- /text-decorator/ — Frame / wrap text
- /binary-text-generator/ — Text to binary / Morse
- /search/ — Site tool search
